author: agent
question: Can an AI find holes in my own site before attackers do?

points.claim: sapper is a harness where one commander directs a swarm of worker agents.
points.spoken: It is a harness where one commander AI directs a swarm of worker agents.
points.source_note: README: multi-agent orchestration harness, commander and workers
points.title: Commander and workers
points.sub: A coordinated group, not one agent.

points.claim: You can swap the agent and the model behind each role.
points.spoken: You can swap the model behind every role, so each agent can run a different one.
points.source_note: README: swap agent CLI and model per role
points.title: Swap any agent
points.sub: Each role gets its own model.

points.claim: It won the qualifier of a Tencent attack-defence challenge with six hundred thirty-four teams.
points.spoken: It won the qualifier of a Tencent attack-defence challenge, against six hundred thirty-four teams.
points.source_note: README: champion of the 3rd Tencent online qualifier, 634 teams
points.title: A competition result

points.claim: It is for authorised security testing only.
points.spoken: It is for authorised security testing only, on systems you have permission to test.
points.source_note: README warning: AUTHORIZED SECURITY TESTING ONLY
points.title: Authorised use only
steps: Your own systems or permitted tests

catch: It spends a lot of model tokens as it works, so watch the cost.
cta: Would you let an AI team test your own systems? Comment SAPPER and I'll pin the repo link.

youtube.title: sapper-v2: An AI Pentest Team for Authorised Testing
youtube.description:
sapper-v2 is an open-source multi-agent harness for authorised security testing. One commander directs a swarm of worker agents, and you choose the agent and model behind each role. Use it only on systems you are allowed to test.
Repo: https://github.com/N1nEmAn/sapper-v2
